text.t:
The ithos®️ wooden lamp, with its delicate silhouette of tiny mushrooms, combines timeless design, cosy light and the charm of small details. Its warm white LED lighting creates a soft and comforting atmosphere, ideal for accompanying moments of reading, tranquillity and snugness before sleep.

During the day, it serves as a decorative piece that adds personality and tenderness to a child's bedroom. With careful finishes and hand-painted details, it integrates harmoniously into environments inspired by nature, soft woods and neutral tones.
Created to make rest moments even sweeter and more special.

options.power.help.t: Batteries are included. The corded version comes with a remote: on, off, dimming, an auto-off timer and a slow pulsing light.

options.engraving.help.t: A name, a date or a short phrase, burned into the wood. Leave it empty if you would rather not.
